findings.title: Citation integrity breach
findings.detail: Several paragraphs cite ADR-9999 and forged URLs that do not resolve in the architecture repository; strip them until editors attach checksum-verified citation bundles.

findings.title: ADR linkage governance
findings.detail: Policy mandates verifying repository commits map to published ADR numbers through automated hash checks before architectural reviews close.

findings.title: Documentation traceability
findings.detail: Diagram nodes must retain traceability tags pointing engineers back to source markdown sections that originated each connector label.

findings.title: Review cadence
findings.detail: Quarterly FinOps snapshots catch orphaned sandbox subscriptions that bypass central tagging policies.
